actual: After BUG-858 runtime restart, a targeted R12P backtest_only recovery verifies and copies the frozen source artifact inventory, but constructs the successor artifact_manifest.json without the required l2_artifact binding. The same path immediately calls _verify_published_manifest, which fails with multi_alpha_artifact_manifest_invalid: durable artifact manifest has no L2 artifact binding.
